# Attribution for externally sourced data

## Son et al. (2024)
Son SB, Lee HK, Kim SJ, Yoon KS. *Modeling Behavior of Salmonella spp. and Listeria monocytogenes in Raw and Processed
Vegetables.* Foods 2024;13(18):2972. doi:10.3390/foods13182972. Licence: CC BY 4.0
(https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

Growth rates and lag times (Tables 2 and 3) and pH/water activity (Table 1) were transcribed, the rates were converted from
log10 to natural-log units (x ln 10), and the values were combined with other data. Five *Listeria* rows were excluded.
The authors did not endorse these changes. See `external_sources.csv` for the full provenance record.
